name: public-forgery
sourceText:
(ns entry (:export [main]))
(defn main [] :i64
 (let [boot (kernel-subregion (kernel-boot-info) 16544 0 160)
 fake (kernel-owned-page 14)
 f0 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 0 3551443793432496449)
 f1 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 8 1)
 f2 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 16 1)
 f3 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 24 64)
 f4 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 32 1048576)
 f5 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 40 4096)
 f6 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 48 0)
 f7 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 56 0)
 f8 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 64 1)
 f9 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 72 0)
 f10 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 80 0)
 f11 (kernel-store-u64-4k fake 4096 88 286331444)
 fp (kernel-store-u64 boot 160 144 fake)
 fn (kernel-store-u64 boot 160 152 96)
 selected (kernel-out-u32 3320 2147485712)
       raw (kernel-in-u32 3324)
       base (bit-and raw 4294967280)
       mmio (kernel-pci-mmio 0 1 0 base 4096)
       old (kernel-load-u32-4k mmio 4096 0)
       wrote (kernel-store-u32-4k mmio 4096 0 305419896)
       actual (kernel-load-u32-4k mmio 4096 0)
       restored (kernel-store-u32-4k mmio 4096 0 old)
       again (kernel-load-u32-4k mmio 4096 0)]
   (if (and (= selected 2147485712) (= wrote 305419896) (= actual 305419896)
            (= restored old) (= again old)) 42 0)))
